locations.name: The Cathedral of St. John the Divine
locations.prompt: The Cathedral of St. John the Divine
locations.factShort: The Cathedral of St. John the Divine (sometimes referred to as St. John's and also nicknamed St. John the Unfinished) is the cathedral of the Episcopal Diocese of New York.

locations.name: The Riegelmann Boardwalk
locations.factShort: The Riegelmann Boardwalk (also known as the Coney Island Boardwalk) is a 2.7-mile-long boardwalk on the southern shore of the Coney Island peninsula of Brooklyn in New York City, New York, United States.

locations.name: MoMA PS1
locations.factShort: MoMA PS1 is a contemporary art museum at 22-01 Jackson Avenue in the Long Island City neighborhood of Queens, in New York City, United States.

locations.name: Crotona Park
locations.factShort: Crotona Park is a public park in the South Bronx in New York City, covering 127.5 acres. The park is bounded by streets of the same name on its northern, eastern, southern, and western borders, and is adjacent to the Crotona Park East and Morrisania neighborhoods of the Bronx.

locations.name: Wolfe's Pond Park
locations.factShort: Wolfe's Pond Park is a large public park located on Staten Island's South Shore. It is bounded on the west by Holton Avenue, on the south by Raritan Bay, on the northwest by the Staten Island Railway, and on the north & east by Chisholm Street, Luten Avenue, and Cornelia Avenue, which is also the main entry into the park's public areas.
